A.question: Which games in other markets belong to the same kind of game family as game GAME_AT_05?

answer.text: The provided sources do not contain information about games in other markets that belong to the Rubbellos product family. Source [1] identifies Edelweiss Instant (GAME_AT_05) as belonging to the Rubbellos product family, and source [2] confirms this classification for the Austrian market. However, none of the other sources describe the product families of games in different markets (such as the UK) as being 'Rubbellos'. Source [3], [4], [6], and [8] identify Lioness Instant (GAME_UK_05) as belonging to the Scratchcard family, and source [7] and [12] identify SwiftSix (GAME_UK_06) as belonging to the Online Instant family. Therefore, based strictly on the provided text, it is not possible to determine which games in other markets belong to the same kind of game family as GAME_AT_05.
